text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Reserved pool 'resv-gpu-14' at 98% utilization. Queue length spike detected (est. 420 pending). Autoscaler error 'scale-limit-hit' in logs. Affected reserved tenants: GreenlineCorp (reserved), PolarisData (shared). Paging oncall: jordan.

jordan: Oncall here. jumping in. Maya + Lee, can you triage? Sam, any customer reports?

maya: Looking at Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/RESV/resv-gpu-14
- queue length: 80 -> 420 over 12m
- p99 latency for reserved inference: 2.2s -> 8.9s
- active sessions: +340 in last 10m
Autoscaler logs show repeated: `error: quotaExceeded` and `scale request rejected: max_instances=10`.

lee: Confirmed policy: resv-gpu-14 has max_instances=10 (set in pool policy). Several customers are pinned to this pool. We hit the configured ceiling, autoscaler refuses to scale beyond. Noisy neighbor pattern from a tenant (PolarisData) — high short-lived sessions.

sam: Greenline on support bridge, reporting 503s and timeouts since the queue grew. They started large batch jobs at ~09:03 UTC. Escalated to priority.

priya: Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Route non-critical/responsive sessions to hosted fallback model (redwood-hosted/gpt-small)
2) Throttle new sessions from noisy tenant (PolarisData) via per-tenant token bucket
3) Temporarily bump pool max_instances to 15 while we provision nodes
Would like to execute 1 + 3 now.

avi: (infra) I can try bumping the cap, but need cloud quota and infra approval. Running infractl now.

avi: ```
infractl pools update resv-gpu-14 --max-instances 15
# response: request accepted, provisioning pending (job id: job-7832)
```

incident-bot: infractl request accepted. Cloud quota check in progress. Provisioning may take ~6-12 minutes depending on region.

maya: Autoscaler still showing provider errors: `quotaExceeded` on API. Workaround: attach warm standby nodes from cold-warm-1 pool and drain queue to them. Lee, can you attach warm nodes?

lee: Running attach script: ```
#!/bin/bash
# bring two warm nodes online and attach to resv-gpu-14
attach-warm-nodes --pool cold-warm-1 --target resv-gpu-14 --count 3
# logs: attached node id: wn-045, wn-046, wn-047
```

lee: Warm nodes attached. Autoscaler now has capacity to schedule pending jobs. Queue length dropping: 420 -> 120 in 4m. Latency p99 falling.

sam: Greenline reports errors reduced to ~1% and most jobs started. They asked for an ETA on full recovery.

priya: We'll keep fallback routing active until pool back to healthy. Also want to add temporary tenant throttling for PolarisData to prevent re-surge. Jordan, do you authorize throttling?

jordan: Authorize throttling for noisy tenant and fallback routing. Make sure we log customer-visible changes and notify support.

avi: Added temporary routing rule: ```
route add --from tenant=polarisdata --to fallback-hosted --policy throttle=30rps
# route applied
```

maya: Monitoring shows queue stabilized at ~30 pending, p99 ~1.1s. Autoscaler provisioning job completed and 3 nodes joined, but cloud quota request flagged for follow-up (we did not exceed provider hard quota yet).

priya: Sam — please update Greenline: partial mitigation in place, errors reduced, full capacity being provisioned. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline once we investigate.

sam: On it. Greenline acknowledged, thanks. They want a post-incident note and confirmation when throttling is removed.

jordan: Handoff plan — my shift ends in 25m. Maya, you're lead for the postmortem and follow-ups. Lee and Priya own infra policy and quota request. Avi continue to monitor routing rules.

maya: Creating follow-ups: [TKT-1234] noisy-tenant-rate-limit (action: implement auto-throttle heuristics), [TKT-1235] pool-capacity-policy-review (action: evaluate dynamic max_instances per pool), [TKT-1236] autoscaler-resilience (action: handle provider quota errors gracefully).

avi: Added temporary tag on pool: `emergency-scaled=true`. Reverting plan: once backlog < 20 for 10m and p99 <1.5s, we'll remove throttling and fallback.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: Queue draining and error rate normalized. Current metrics: utilization 72%, queue 14, p99 latency 1.0s. Monitoring window set for 60m.

jordan: Closing pager for now. Thanks all — good coordination. Maya, please share RCA draft and customer note template when ready.

maya: Will draft RCA and next-steps. Initial hypothesis: pool max_instances too conservative given pinned-reserved workloads + lack of automatic noisy-tenant throttling. Also autoscaler should fallback better when provider quota responses occur.

priya: I'll prep customer-facing language and coordinate with sales for Greenline.

sam: Greenline confirmed degraded state resolved and appreciated fast response. Keeping bridge open for now.

maya: Marking incident as mitigated and creating postmortem meeting invite. Follow-ups assigned. Monitoring to continue.

jordan: :white_check_mark: good job. Handing off to Maya for the postmortem and long-term fixes.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation in place). Remember to file postmortem within 72 hours and link any relevant logs and infra changes.
